title: SENTIMENT_METRIC_V1
description: JSON schema for Observe.ai bulk S3 export of sentiment metric records. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON (SENTIMENT_METRIC_V1_<timestamp>.json.gz). Each record is one JSON object.

interaction_id.description: Observe.ai interaction identifier this record relates to.

interaction_time.description: UTC timestamp of the related interaction.

sentiment_score.description: Overall agent sentiment score for the interaction.

agent.description: Agent-side sentiment metrics (dynamic keys) plus overall sentiment score.

sentiment_score.description: Overall customer sentiment score for the interaction.

customer.description: Customer-side sentiment metrics (dynamic keys) plus overall sentiment score.

metrics.description: Sentiment metric values computed for the interaction.

modified_at.description: UTC timestamp when the record was last modified.
